status: PHOTO-DERIVED representatives cut from photographs supplied by the repository owner. Albedo is the delit photograph; height, normal, roughness and ambient occlusion are single-image heuristic estimates; physical scale is estimated from objects in frame; nothing here is photogrammetry or a survey. The 4k masters and 2k tier are interpolated above each material's native_source_px.
